title: Clean slate TaxKit foundation — implementation slices
authority: Cooper explicitly authorised implementation, reviewable commits and draft PRs on 2026-10-04. No merge, deploy or publication; provider-plan approval remains separate.
principles: Retain tax rules/results and their proof while replacing application foundations.

Use immutable Schema-derived values and declarative, pipe-first Effect workflows across all owned apps/packages/tests/scripts/infrastructure; no local mutation, imperative loops or helper sprawl. Necessary state has a scoped React/Effect owner and pure updates.
One primary owner integrates and accepts whole slices; agent or test counts do not establish proof.
Every required owning document, README, rule, export, generated source, skill and runbook changes within the affected slice.
Use current qualified exact dependencies; no silent downgrade, broad exception or unproved peer override.
Each task is pending until its actual postconditions and applicable checks pass. Proposed tasks do not authorise cloud changes.
